steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Line voltage at terminal block
steps.body: Remove access panel and terminal box cover. Volts AC: black probe on white terminal screw (N), red on black screw (L1). Plug in power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If 120 VAC is present, proceed to P4 check.

steps.title: 120 VAC at terminal block?
steps.body: Is 120 VAC present at the dishwasher terminal block (L1 to N)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is 120 VAC present at the dishwasher terminal block (L1 to N)?

steps.title: Correct customer power
steps.body: Have customer correct outlet, breaker, or installation wiring before continuing ACU diagnosis.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Have customer correct outlet, breaker, or installation wiring before continuing ACU diagnosis.

steps.title: 120 VAC at P4?
steps.body: Power off. Remove outer door panel. At connector P4: pin 1 (L1) to pin 4 (N) with power applied — expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove outer door panel. At connector P4: pin 1 (L1) to pin 4 (N) with power applied — expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Repair terminal-to-P4 harness
steps.body: Check for open connection between terminal block and control P4. Repair harness or terminals as needed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check for open connection between terminal block and control P4. Repair harness or terminals as needed.

steps.title: 5 VDC and 13 VDC present?
steps.body: With power on: 5 VDC from P11A-2 or P11B-2 to P10-2 (DC GND). 13 VDC from P11-7 to P10-2. Both within ±5%?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With power on: 5 VDC from P11A-2 or P11B-2 to P10-2 (DC GND). 13 VDC from P11-7 to P10-2. Both within ±5%?

steps.title: Isolate loaded-down supply
steps.body: Power off. Disconnect loads from control one connector at a time. Restore power and retest missing supply. Replace control if supply stays missing with all loads disconnected.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Disconnect loads from control one connector at a time. Restore power and retest missing supply. Replace control if supply stays missing with all loads disconnected.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.body: Replace electronic control if DC supplies or P4 input failed after harness repair.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace electronic control if DC supplies or P4 input failed after harness repair.

steps.title: Power verified
steps.body: Incoming and on-board power supplies verified — reassemble and retest operation.
steps.oemOutcome: Incoming and on-board power supplies verified — reassemble and retest operation.
